notes.title: Steam Store page is live!
notes.content:
You can now see Scary Stories's Steam page on the store!
Please freely use the Workshop & Discussions tab here on Steam to talk about the game or share your own Scary Stories from the in-game Editor.

Check out the new store page here!

Thank you all for testing out the game- there will continue to be updates until public early access and so if you find any bugs or have any feedback at all please do reach out! 

Progress Update:
Settled on a release timeline
A Halloween release has always been the goal and although I feel the game could still use some work I hope to release into public early access early 2025 and aim to fully release Oct 2025.

In-game Story Editor is nearly ready!
Progress is coming along well, the in-game Editor is now functional and though it still requires testing/fleshing-out, you can access it by using the command "editor unlock" in the "F1" command menu.

Scary Stories is now also now multilingual!
I had thought about this early on in development as this could not only allow the game to be played no matter what your preferred language but as the game is primarily text based its quite easy to swap it out for a Google Translated version and so that's what it currently does. (Currently Russian is the only other language, but more languages will be added as development continues)



- Devlin
